"""READ_ONLY guardrail for SQL runtime bootstrap.

Inspects only environment variable NAMES from the live backend process and
shell structure from /entrypoint.sh. It never reads .env contents or prints
environment values.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


CANONICAL_SQL_ENV = (
    "EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST",
    "EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT",
    "EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE",
    "EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER",
    "EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD",
)


def _backend_pid() -> int:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["supervisorctl", "status", "backend"],
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
        timeout=10,
    )
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (
        "BACKEND_SUPERVISOR_STATUS_FAILED:"
        f"rc={proc.returncode}"
    )
    match = re.search(r"\\bpid\\s+(\\d+)\\b", proc.stdout or "")
    assert match is not None, "BACKEND_PID_NOT_FOUND"
    return int(match.group(1))


def _backend_env_names(pid: int) -> set[str]:
    path = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/environ")
    assert path.is_file(), "BACKEND_ENVIRON_UNAVAILABLE"
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {
        item.split(b"=", 1)[0].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        for item in raw.split(b"\\0")
        if b"=" in item
    }


def _entrypoint_semantics() -> dict[str, bool]:
    path = Path("/entrypoint.sh")
    assert path.is_file(), "ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND"

    syntax = subprocess.run(
        ["bash", "-n", str(path)],
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
        timeout=10,
    )
    assert syntax.returncode == 0, "ENTRYPOINT_BASH_SYNTAX_INVALID"

    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    supervisor_line = None
    for number, raw in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        text = raw.strip()
        if text.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if "supervisord" in text or "supervisorctl" in text:
            supervisor_line = number
            break

    pre = lines if supervisor_line is None else lines[: supervisor_line - 1]

    has_env_reference = any(
        ".env" in line.lower() or "env_file" in line.lower()
        for line in pre
        if not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
    )
    has_source = any(
        re.search(r"(^|[;&|()\\s])(source|\\.)\\s+[^#]*", line)
        and (
            ".env" in line.lower()
            or "env_file" in line.lower()
            or "$ENV" in line.upper()
        )
        for line in pre
        if not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
    )
    has_autoexport = any(
        re.search(r"(^|[;&|()\\s])set\\s+(-a|-o\\s+allexport)(\\s|$)", line)
        for line in pre
        if not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
    )

    return {
        "has_env_reference_before_supervisor": has_env_reference,
        "has_source_before_supervisor": has_source,
        "has_autoexport_before_supervisor": has_autoexport,
    }


def test_backend_runtime_receives_canonical_sql_environment_names():
    pid = _backend_pid()
    names = _backend_env_names(pid)
    missing = sorted(set(CANONICAL_SQL_ENV) - names)
    semantics = _entrypoint_semantics()

    assert not missing, (
        "BACKEND_CANONICAL_SQL_ENV_MISSING:"
        + ",".join(missing)
        + "|entrypoint_env_reference="
        + str(int(semantics["has_env_reference_before_supervisor"]))
        + "|entrypoint_source="
        + str(int(semantics["has_source_before_supervisor"]))
        + "|entrypoint_autoexport="
        + str(int(semantics["has_autoexport_before_supervisor"]))
    )


def test_entrypoint_has_pre_supervisor_environment_bootstrap_signal():
    semantics = _entrypoint_semantics()
    assert semantics["has_env_reference_before_supervisor"], (
        "ENTRYPOINT_NO_ENV_REFERENCE_BEFORE_SUPERVISOR"
    )

objective: Agregar y ejecutar un guardrail bounded para certificar que el proceso backend uvicorn recibe los cinco nombres canonicos EDARSAHUB_SQL_* y que /entrypoint.sh tiene senal de bootstrap de entorno antes de Supervisor. El guardrail no debe leer contenidos .env ni imprimir valores de entorno. Si el runtime no cumple, bloquear sin integrar cambios. No SQL, no reinicios, no Produccion, no 019.
